subtitle: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <functional> header. 34 of 44 symbols shipped: the 33-symbol first batch (function objects, reference wrappers, invoke family, bind-support trait primaries, bad_function_call, hash) plus re_std::function. The remaining 10 are deferred — move_only_function / copyable_function / function_ref pending signature-qualifier parsing, the bind family pending re_std::tuple, and the searchers pending re_std::algorithm.
legend_blurb: Per-symbol coverage of C++ <functional>. 34/44 shipped (function objects, reference wrappers, the invoke family, hash, and re_std::function); move_only_function / copyable_function / function_ref, the bind family, and the searchers are deferred.

symbols.name: bit_and
symbols.notes: Binary &. Transparent void specialisation in C++14.
symbols.failure_reason: Not a hard language ceiling: the per-type primary needs no C++11 feature and compiles on C++98. Floored at C++11 to match std's introduction of the bitwise function objects in C++11 (and the module's uniform C++11 gate); a C++98 back-port is possible and tracked as optional. The transparent-void specialisation is independently C++14.

symbols.name: bit_or
symbols.notes: Binary |. Transparent void specialisation in C++14.
symbols.failure_reason: Not a hard language ceiling: the per-type primary compiles on C++98. Floored at C++11 to match std's C++11 introduction of the bitwise function objects; C++98 back-port possible and tracked as optional. Transparent-void specialisation is C++14.

symbols.name: bit_xor
symbols.notes: Binary ^. Transparent void specialisation in C++14.
symbols.failure_reason: Not a hard language ceiling: the per-type primary compiles on C++98. Floored at C++11 to match std's C++11 introduction of the bitwise function objects; C++98 back-port possible and tracked as optional. Transparent-void specialisation is C++14.

symbols.name: bit_not
symbols.notes: Unary ~. Added later than the other bitwise function objects.
symbols.failure_reason: Not a hard language ceiling: the per-type primary compiles on C++98. std introduced bit_not in C++14; re_std already back-ports it to C++11 and could back-port further to C++98, but floors it at C++11 with the rest of the module. C++98 back-port tracked as optional. Transparent-void specialisation is C++14.

symbols.name: reference_wrapper
symbols.notes: Copyable, assignable wrapper around a reference. Member operator T&() and operator() (via invoke) became constexpr in C++20 (P1065). Unblocks make_pair / make_tuple reference_wrapper unwrapping when shipped.
symbols.failure_reason: C++11 language ceiling: the rvalue-deleted constructor and the variadic, perfect-forwarding call operator (dispatching through re_std::invoke) require rvalue references and variadic templates. No C++98 path.

symbols.name: ref
symbols.notes: Factory producing reference_wrapper<T>. Two overloads (lvalue / rvalue=deleted). noexcept on all tiers; constexpr from C++20.
symbols.failure_reason: C++11 language ceiling: returns re_std::reference_wrapper (itself C++11) and provides a reference_wrapper passthrough overload. Cannot predate reference_wrapper.

symbols.name: cref
symbols.notes: Factory producing reference_wrapper<const T>. Two overloads (lvalue / rvalue=deleted).
symbols.failure_reason: C++11 language ceiling: returns re_std::reference_wrapper (itself C++11) and provides a reference_wrapper passthrough overload. Cannot predate reference_wrapper.

symbols.name: unwrap_reference
symbols.notes: Trait: yields T& if T is reference_wrapper<U>, otherwise T. Used by bind_front and friends.
symbols.failure_reason: C++11 language ceiling: defined in terms of re_std::reference_wrapper (C++11); back-ported from C++20 down to C++11 but no further. Cannot predate reference_wrapper.

symbols.name: unwrap_ref_decay
symbols.notes: Composes decay_t and unwrap_reference. Replaces the C++17 reference_wrapper-aware decay used by make_pair / make_tuple.
symbols.failure_reason: C++11 language ceiling: computed as unwrap_reference<decay_t<T>>, both C++11-floored via reference_wrapper. Back-ported from C++20 to C++11; cannot predate reference_wrapper.

symbols.name: invoke
symbols.notes: Generalised callable invocation. Dispatches across regular callables, pointer-to-member-function, pointer-to-member-data, and reference_wrapper. Unblocks tuple::apply, is_invocable, is_nothrow_invocable, etc.
symbols.failure_reason: C++11 language ceiling: the INVOKE overload set needs variadic templates and perfect forwarding, each bullet SFINAE-selected on the decltype of a forwarded call. No C++98 formulation.

symbols.name: invoke_r
symbols.notes: invoke with an explicit return type, allowing implicit conversion or void-discard.
symbols.failure_reason: C++11 language ceiling: wraps invoke with an explicit return type, inheriting invoke's variadic + perfect-forwarding requirement.

symbols.name: function
symbols.notes: Type-erased polymorphic callable wrapper for any signature R(Args...). re_std implementation: a heap-allocated holder behind an abstract base (internal::fn_base / fn_holder) that dispatches through re_std::invoke, so pointer-to-member-function, pointer-to-member-data, reference_wrapper, function-pointer, and functor/lambda targets all work uniformly. target<T>() is RTTI-free (address-based type id, like any_type_id); target_type() is additionally gated on D_ENV_CPP98_HAS_TYPEINFO. A null function/member-pointer target constructs an empty wrapper, matching std; the constrained constructor/assignment use a local is_invocable_r stand-in (result-convertibility enforced). Requires a CopyConstructible target, as std does. Never constexpr (heap + RTTI). SBO is a documented follow-on optimisation; the deprecated (C++11) / removed (C++17) allocator-taking constructors are intentionally omitted.
symbols.failure_reason: C++11 language ceiling: the R(Args...) signature pack needs variadic templates and move / perfect-forwarding construction needs rvalue references (the whole header is gated on both, like invoke). Heap type erasure. A conforming C++98 function would require Boost.Function-style fixed-arity (arity 0..N) specialisations — deliberately deferred as a follow-on. SBO is a further pending optimisation.

symbols.name: bad_function_call
symbols.notes: Thrown by function::operator() when the wrapper is empty. Conditional inheritance of std::exception when D_ENV_CPP98_HAS_EXCEPTION (mirrors bad_any_cast / bad_optional_access).

symbols.name: move_only_function
symbols.notes: Move-only counterpart to function. Supports cv-, ref-, and noexcept-qualified call signatures.
symbols.failure_reason: Type-erasure infrastructure now exists (see function.hpp). Remaining blockers: move-only holder storage (function's holder requires a CopyConstructible target) and signature-qualifier parsing for cv- / ref- / noexcept-qualified call signatures. std C++23.

symbols.name: copyable_function
symbols.notes: C++26 successor to function with the same qualifier surface as move_only_function.
symbols.failure_reason: Type-erasure infrastructure now exists (function.hpp). Remaining blockers: the const / ref / noexcept qualifier-parsing surface it shares with move_only_function, plus C++26 finalisation.

symbols.name: function_ref
symbols.notes: Non-owning callable view. Trivially constexpr-friendly (no allocation).
symbols.failure_reason: Non-owning callable view. Type-erasure groundwork exists (function.hpp), but function_ref stores a bound-entity pointer plus an erased invoker rather than owning the target, so it needs its own allocation-free, trivially-copyable representation. std C++26.

symbols.name: bind
symbols.notes: Partial-application binder. Result is callable; not constexpr in std (the call uses invoke + tuple-like storage of arguments).
symbols.failure_reason: Pending re_std::functional milestone. Requires variadic templates, perfect forwarding, tuple-like argument storage, and the placeholder protocol (C++11+).

symbols.name: bind_front
symbols.notes: Forward-args-only binder; no placeholders. Constexpr from inception. BACKFILLED 2026-08-25. Stores callable and bound prefix by decayed value; four ref-qualified call operators so an rvalue adaptor moves its bound args out. Needs no placeholder protocol, which is why it ships before bind.
symbols.failure_reason: Ships at C++11, which is below the workbook C++98 floor. Floor question, not a coverage gap -- see the OPEN tier-floor item.

symbols.name: bind_back
symbols.notes: Like bind_front but appends bound args after the call args. BACKFILLED 2026-08-25. Mirror of bind_front; bound pack expands after the call arguments.
symbols.failure_reason: Ships at C++11, which is below the workbook C++98 floor. Floor question, not a coverage gap -- see the OPEN tier-floor item.

symbols.name: is_bind_expression
symbols.notes: Trait: detects whether a type is the result of bind. User-specialisable for custom binders.
symbols.failure_reason: Not a hard language ceiling: the primary template (false_type) compiles on C++98. Floored at C++11 to match std's C++11 introduction; a C++98 back-port is possible and tracked as optional. Ships as a primary only until bind supplies the specialisations.

symbols.name: is_placeholder
symbols.notes: Trait: yields the 1-based placeholder index, or 0 for non-placeholders.
symbols.failure_reason: Not a hard language ceiling: the primary template (integral_constant<int,0>) compiles on C++98. Floored at C++11 to match std's C++11 introduction; a C++98 back-port is possible and tracked as optional. Ships as a primary only until bind supplies the specialisations.

symbols.name: placeholders::_1 ... _N
symbols.notes: Inline-namespace constants used by bind. The standard guarantees at least _1 through _10. re_std will provide the same range.
symbols.failure_reason: Pending re_std::functional milestone. Requires inline-namespace placement (C++11+).

symbols.name: mem_fn
symbols.notes: Wraps a pointer-to-member-function or pointer-to-member-data into a uniform callable object. Constexpr from C++20 (P1065).
symbols.failure_reason: C++11 language ceiling: returns a variadic, perfect-forwarding callable that dispatches through re_std::invoke. No C++98 path.

symbols.name: not_fn
symbols.notes: Returns a callable that negates the wrapped predicate via invoke. Replaces the deprecated not1 / not2.
symbols.failure_reason: C++11 language ceiling: stores the target by decayed value and negates a variadic, forwarded re_std::invoke call. Needs variadic templates + rvalue references.

symbols.name: identity
symbols.notes: Transparent passthrough: returns its argument unchanged via perfect forwarding. Used as a default projection in <ranges>.
symbols.failure_reason: C++11 language ceiling: the perfect-forwarding call operator requires rvalue references. (std introduced identity in C++20; re_std back-ports to C++11, the language floor.)

symbols.name: hash
symbols.notes: Primary template plus standard specialisations for arithmetic types, pointers, nullptr_t, string-likes, optional, variant, etc. The arithmetic specialisations are trivial; container specialisations require the corresponding container modules.
symbols.failure_reason: Floored at C++11 to match std::hash's introduction. The primary and the integer / pointer / floating-point specialisations are individually C++98-capable, but the char16_t/char32_t and nullptr_t specialisations and the module's C++11 constexpr posture set the floor (char8_t additionally requires C++20).

symbols.name: default_searcher
symbols.notes: Trivial naive searcher. The default for std::search.
symbols.failure_reason: Pending re_std::functional milestone (and re_std::algorithm for std::search itself).

symbols.name: boyer_moore_searcher
symbols.notes: Boyer-Moore string searcher. Precomputes bad-character and good-suffix tables in its ctor; never constexpr (heap-allocated tables).
symbols.failure_reason: Pending re_std::functional milestone (and re_std::algorithm).

symbols.name: boyer_moore_horspool_searcher
symbols.notes: Boyer-Moore-Horspool string searcher. Smaller table than full BM; never constexpr.
symbols.failure_reason: Pending re_std::functional milestone (and re_std::algorithm).
